sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to extend their exceptional form. The league leaders have won their last match and impressively recorded five consecutive wins before that, giving them a commanding position with 22 points from 10 games. They face a struggling Alsager Town side, who sit bottom of the table with just 4 points and have lost their last five games, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to maintain their title credentials.
divisionWide: The weekend sees a congested fixture programme with ten matches across the division. Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town, offering a chance to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after drawing their most recent match. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third, face a stern test at home against Eccleshall, who occupy fifth place and are seeking to bounce back from a recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome struggling Wednesfield Community in a clash between mid-table sides, while in-form Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir in a fixture between teams showing positive recent form. Brereton Social host winless Widnes Town in what shapes as a potential opportunity for the hosts to build momentum. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a bottom-half clash between two sides with poor records, while Crewe host Allscott Heath in another fixture between struggling teams. Market Drayton Town face a tough test at New Mills, and Shawbury United host Barnton as both teams seek consistency.
